backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the MBG management system, defining persistent stores for beneficiaries (Sasaran), packages (PaketMBG), and distributions (Distribusi), along with CRUD endpoints, user profile management, statistics, and access control.
backend/migration.mo: Defines the stable migration module for the backend actor, declaring old and new actor state shapes (sasaranStore, paketStore, distribusiStore, nextId, userProfiles) and a no-op `run` migration function.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming high-confidence implementation of the searchable, village-grouped beneficiary checklist selector in the Catat Distribusi page, referencing the relevant frontend files and test ID REQ-1.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of every frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the frontend codebase structure and component responsibilities.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining OKLCH-based design tokens for light and dark themes, including colors for background, foreground, primary, destructive, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app, setting Indonesian language, loading jsPDF from CDN, and mounting the React root div with the main module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application component using TanStack Router that conditionally renders LoginPage or Dashboard based on Internet Identity authentication state, wrapped in ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/BeneficiaryCheck: Reusable component that renders a searchable, village-grouped checklist of active Sasaran records with expand/collapse per desa, per-village select-all, selected-beneficiary summary chips, and an onChange callback exposing selected IDs.
frontend/src/components/DashboardHome.ts: Dashboard home page component displaying the UPTD DALDUK PKK logo, statistics cards (total sasaran, paket, distribusi), program information, and quick-access navigation buttons to main features.
frontend/src/components/DistribusiPage.t: React page component for managing food distribution records, supporting batch creation with beneficiary selection, status tracking, and filtering/searching of distribution history.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky navigation header component with desktop and mobile nav menus for the dashboard, displaying the app logo, active menu highlighting, username, and a logout button.
frontend/src/components/LaporanPage.tsx: Report generation page that fetches distribution data filtered by date range and beneficiary category, then exports the results as a PDF file.
frontend/src/components/PaketPage.tsx: Page component for managing MBG food package data, allowing users to search existing packages and add new ones via a dialog form with package type selection.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Empty file with no content; likely a placeholder for a profile setup modal component.
frontend/src/components/SasaranPage.tsx: Page component for managing beneficiary (sasaran) records, supporting search, adding new beneficiaries with category selection, and toggling active/inactive status.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, initializing access control with an admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend canister interactions including CRUD operations for beneficiaries (sasaran), packages (paket), and distributions (distribusi), plus statistics queries.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the design system's light and dark color themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider into the root DOM element.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page component that manages active menu state and renders the appropriate sub-page (home, sasaran, paket, distribusi, or laporan) along with a header and footer.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page component that displays a government branding header and a card with an Internet Identity login button, showing a loading spinner during the login process.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration that maps OKLCH CSS variables to semantic color tokens, defines border radius and animation keyframes, and registers typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks project state for a distribution recording app with beneficiary management, including existing features and pending requests for a checklist-based beneficiary selector grouped by village and batch distribution record creation.
